notes/Personal Knowledge Management.md.title: Personal Knowledge Management
notes/Personal Knowledge Management.md.summary: Outlines the author's PKM system and philosophy: capture quickly, process regularly, connect actively, review periodically. Documents tools used (Obsidian, Git, automated agents) and identifies maintenance as the core challenge.
